description: This file defines the ViewJson class which is responsible for rendering a JSON representation of a CRM bean's data in SuiteCRM. It extends the SugarView class and implements a display method that processes bean fields and outputs them as JSON.

classes.name: ViewJson
classes.description: A view class responsible for returning a CRM bean's data in JSON format within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the parent SugarView class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and outputs JSON-encoded data of the bean's fields, replacing new lines with HTML breaks.
